qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Diversified French conglomerate spanning civil engineering/roadbuilding (Colas), energy services (Equans), mobile/fixed telecom (Bouygues Telecom), and linear media (TF1). Structural consolidated ROIC of 3-5% and operating margins of ~4% fail the >=12% hurdle across cycles due to competitive public bidding in construction and telecom quad-play price competition.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Proof of Moat & Pricing Power, ROIC 3-5% << 12% hurdle, REJECT). French conglomerate combining thin-margin competitive contracting, capital-heavy telecom, and legacy linear television. Operating margins of 3.5-4.5% reflect competitive tender dynamics lacking durable pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: Consolidated ROIC has averaged 3.0%-5.0% between 2020 and 2024, far below the 12% cost-of-capital threshold. Operating margins remain modest at 3.5%-4.5%. Acquisition of Equans in 2022 added €6.5B+ to invested capital in low-margin multi-technical installation without establishing pricing power.
